Chapter 6179: One And Only Dingtian

Chapter 6179: One And Only Dingtian

“Dao Brother, be ready to face my ultimate move.” Immortal Suppressor held the cauldron and shouted with lightning coursing in his eyes.

He was the lord of thunder in this epoch descending to the mortal world.

“Show me just how brilliant your last move can be.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Very well, it shall be glorious!” He roared as his primal anima grew a pair of light wings.

He burned his true blood and space evaporated. All affinities were melted into a single force and channeled to the cauldron.

“The one and only Dingtian!” The cauldron became the only light in this world as everything else fell into darkness.

The only light blinded everyone, nullifying emperors and desolate gods’ heavenly gazes.

The cauldron turned into a true dragon and soared for Li Qiye. It summoned a world full of draconic lairs. Millions of dragons appeared; their roars alone shattered the stars.

They immediately transformed into the heaven and used it as a tool for battle. This was the limit of the dao since the heaven surpassed all other existences.

The tallest being still wasn’t taller than the heaven. The strongest cultivator wasn’t stronger either.

“Boom!” Sin couldn’t withstand the draconic heaven. Shockwaves spread in all directions and flattened everything along the way.

This spelled an end to the already damaged Immortal Suppression Dynasty. The remnant ruins turned into smoke.

The area around Li Qiye was reduced to the very beginning - a chaotic expanse devoid of any affinities and essences. Only Li Qiye remained, pushing the cauldron back with one hand.

“Extremity, Seal!” Immortal Suppressor channeled all of his vitality into the cauldron. The epoch and its living beings contracted to a single point.

“A bit interesting.” Li Qiye smiled after seeing the focus point.

“Boom!” The collapse of the epoch resulted in an unimaginable level of power stemming from all possible affinities and karmas.

Spectators’ soul left their body in fear after witnessing the power core. This thing if left unchecked could do the same to Sin, condensing them down into energy.

The core joined together with the cauldron, initiating an even greater suction force. Everything disappeared into the cauldron including Li Qiye.

“Is he captured?” Someone asked.

The grotto could no longer be seen along with other visual phenomena. Not a single speck of dust was left when not counting Immortal Suppressor and his cauldron.

“Did Li Qiye lose?” An emperor murmured.

“Can’t be.” A desolate god said: “This is probably not enough to kill him.”

Ultimately, everyone thought Li Qiye was unbeatable despite his sudden disappearance.

“A singularity collapse is enough to destroy an epoch.” A timeworn big shot said.

“Yes, even the Indestructible Diamond Physique would be reduced to dust to join the singularity.” An ancient ancestor said.

“Well, it wasn’t a true epoch, just the power of the cauldron. It doesn’t contain everything substantial, so it can’t kill an overlord.” An emperor disagreed.

They believed Li Qiye was a supreme overlord, it’s just that he had yet to display his true cultivation.

Thus, although Immortal Suppressor could use the cauldron with his master’s help, he was still only a primal ancestor. The power gap was insurmountable so Li Qiye was only temporarily trapped.
